title: BlobStorageInfo
description: BlobStorageInfo contains details about the data stored in Blob Storage for the referenced resource. Note: Storage class is only valid for DICOM and hence will only be populated for DICOM resources.

storageClassUpdateTime.description: The time at which the storage class was updated. This is used to compute early deletion fees of the resource.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes of data stored in Blob Storage.

storageClass.description: The storage class in which the Blob data is stored.
